# Amazon Bedrock Agents

Manage local agents, immutable versions, aliases, action groups and vector knowledge-base metadata.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-bedrock-agents) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Managed OpenSearch domain storage is unsupported and its configuration member is not whitelisted. Pinecone, Redis Enterprise Cloud, MongoDB Atlas, Neptune Analytics and S3 Vectors stores are metadata only because their services are absent.
- No embeddings, ingestion jobs, documents, retrieval, flows, prompts, collaborators, supervisor modes, VPC configurations or resource policies; only S3 data sources and VECTOR knowledge bases are supported.
- Knowledge-base configuration changes fail explicitly as documented by UpdateKnowledgeBase; CloudFormation still treats StorageConfiguration as replacement and sends other updates in place. Prompt overrides and memory configuration are stored faithfully as configuration; prompts are not run and summaries are never synthesized. An agent without overrides returns an empty promptOverrideConfiguration rather than AWS's default prompt templates. Custom orchestration and provisioned throughput alias routing are unsupported.
- Numbered versions retain snapshots. Alias deletion is synchronous; agent deletion remains visible until GetAgent observes DELETING. These deterministic transitions do not simulate AWS timing.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
